must_contain: NHA's M2 document gives the link token a validity of six months
validate it before use rather than assuming it is still good
if it has expired, regenerate it through demographic authentication before linking
notes: pronoun follow-up refers back to the link token; the second answer is the same glossary atom's own expiry and revalidation guidance, so it stays consistent with the first answer.
